title: How to Compress a Video for WhatsApp on iPhone (2026)
description: Video too large for WhatsApp or arriving blurry? Compress it on iPhone first so you control quality, or send it as a document up to 2 GB. Step by step.
h1: How to compress a video for WhatsApp on iPhone
card_summary: Stop WhatsApp from mangling your video: compress it yourself or send it as a document.
keywords: compress video for whatsapp iphone, video too large to send on whatsapp, send long video whatsapp iphone, whatsapp video blurry
quick_answer: WhatsApp recompresses videos you send as media, which is why they arrive blurry or get refused. Compress the clip yourself in Compress Video (resolution slider at about 50% for 4K clips, HEVC), then send it. To keep full quality, attach the compressed file as a Document instead: WhatsApp accepts documents up to 2 GB without recompressing them.
intro: WhatsApp optimises for speed, not quality. Long or big clips get squeezed hard, and very large ones don't send at all.
Doing the compression yourself means you decide the trade-off.

sections.heading: What size to aim for
paragraphs: For inline playback keep clips short and at 720p–1080p. For documents, the smaller the file, the faster it uploads and downloads for everyone in a group.

steps.heading: Compress and send a video to WhatsApp
steps.intro: Works for chats, groups and Status.

items.name: Open the clip
items.text: Open Compress Video and pick the video, or share it from Photos into the app.

items.name: Trim
items.text: Tap Trim Video; for Status, keep the part you want to post.

items.name: Compress
items.text: In Compress settings drag the resolution slider to about 50% for 4K clips (≈ 1080p) or lower for long videos, keep the audio, and tap Compress.

items.name: Share to WhatsApp
items.text: Tap Download Compressed and share to WhatsApp, or in WhatsApp tap + → Document and pick the file from Files to avoid recompression.

faq.question: Why are my WhatsApp videos blurry?
faq.answer: WhatsApp recompresses media to save data. Send the clip as a Document, or compress it yourself first so WhatsApp has less to squeeze.

faq.question: How do I send a long video on WhatsApp?
faq.answer: Trim and compress it in Compress Video, then send it as a Document. Documents can be up to 2 GB.
